title.zh: 【Crypto.com 面向美国用户推出预测市场产品 Predict Pro】
title.en: 【Crypto.com 面向美国用户推出预测市场产品 Predict Pro】

current_state.zh: Crypto.com Exchange launched Predict Pro, a US-facing prediction market for real-world events including sports, elections, and crypto prices, supporting a live order book, multiple order types, and 2-6 leg combination trades.
